description.text: The complete supplied character reference sheet holds the frame exactly as delivered, its tall vertical layout intact from top to bottom: the large rainy rooftop panel occupying the upper portion, the three full-body studio turnaround views beneath it, and the four detail close-ups along the bottom edge, with every printed caption line still clear and unmoved in its original place. In the big top panel a lean adult with short dark hair shaved at the sides and a small topknot stands on a wet urban rooftop at night in a slight three-quarter turn, wearing a high-collared black tactical jacket with straps and metal buckles, a black T-shirt, black cargo trousers and heavy black lace-up combat boots, a diagonal scar set above one eyebrow. Rain streaks steadily down through the cool blue-gray air; water beads on the metal railing and spreads across the reflective paving, where warm amber points from distant lit windows smear and shimmer. Behind the figure, blurred towers and glowing windows recede into the wet dark, and the fine drizzle drifting through the amber pools of light gives the still panel its first breath of life. The middle row keeps its near-black backdrop, low-key directional light raking the front, side profile and back silhouettes so the grain of the fabric, the strap hardware and the cut of the jacket read cleanly; the four close-ups hold their soft contrast, the calm direct gaze and the scar, the buckled collar, the weathered hands with visible veins and knuckles, the thick-soled laced boots. Under the falling rain the whole sheet settles into an unhurried floating drift, the panels shifting against one another with a faint parallax as wet highlights slide across the paving; droplets track down the glassy reflections of the hero panel, the set of the figure's shoulders and the loose edge of the topknot stir almost imperceptibly, and the studio panels deepen and lift by turns as the light creeps across them. Nothing is cropped, redrawn or rearranged: the layout, the printed captions and the standing pose persist through to the final instant, an intact reference plate quietly coming alive.
Soft, steady rain falls on the wet rooftop, with a faint dripping and a low distant city hum beneath it.
The entire reference sheet is present, hero rooftop panel above the studio turnaround views and the four detail close-ups, every caption line legible in place.
Droplets begin tracking down the glassy reflections and the wet paving, and the amber points from distant windows waver and stretch across the rain-slicked surface.
The sheet drifts without hurry, its panels offsetting slightly against each other while the low-key studio views deepen and lift as the light creeps over the dark backdrop.
The figure's shoulders and the loose edge of the topknot stir almost imperceptibly as rain keeps streaking past, the three-quarter standing pose and the full layout unchanged.
The camera pans right with small amplitude at slow speed.
